description: Report only the invoices that have line items, ranked by how many line items they have.

a.request: For each invoice that has at least one line item, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and its number of line items. List the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest.
a.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_product_cost, 0)) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS num_line_items FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY num_line_items DESC, invoice_number LIMIT 10;

c.request: For each invoice, show the invoice number, the average ratio of `derived_total_cost` to `derived_product_cost` across its line items, and how many line items it has. Give the 10 invoices with the most line items, from most to fewest. Report only the invoices that have line items, ranked by how many line items they have.
c.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_total_to_product_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC, invoice_number ASC LIMIT 10;

b.request: Report only invoices that have at least one line item in Invoice_Line_Items, showing each invoice's number, the average of derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost across its line items, and its line item count, ordered by line item count descending, limited to the top 10.
b.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
b.raw: Report only invoices that have at least one line item in Invoice_Line_Items, showing each invoice's number, the average of derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost across its line items, and its line item count, ordered by line item count descending, limited to the top 10.

d.request: Among invoices that have at least one line item, list each invoice's number, the average of derived_total_cost / derived_product_cost over its line items, and its line-item count, sorted by line-item count descending, limited to 10.
d.sql: SELECT invoice_number, AVG(derived_total_cost * 1.0 / derived_product_cost) AS avg_total_to_product_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) AS line_item_count FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ORDER BY line_item_count DESC LIMIT 10;
